title: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)
summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), established by clinical and laboratory findings (see 11.00O). Laboratory testing is required when clinical findings of upper and lower motor neuron disease are not present in three or more regions.

children.criterion: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), established by clinical and laboratory findings (see 11.00O). Documentation based on generally accepted methods consistent with prevailing medical practice. Laboratory testing required when clinical findings of UMN and LMN disease are not present in three or more regions.
Diagnosis established by clinical findings alone (when UMN+LMN signs present in 3+ regions) OR by clinical + laboratory findings
Clinical findings of upper and lower motor neuron disease in three or more regions (sufficient on their own without EMG/NCS)
Laboratory testing (electrophysiological studies such as EMG/NCS) supporting the diagnosis when clinical findings are not present in three or more regions
